summary: Prospective independently versioned FS.GG.Telemetry.Host 0.6.0 bundles the current Store14 implementation and accepts provider-usage-observation/1 through the existing authenticated generic receipt route. Envelope and receipt ABI remain unchanged. Passive facts retain authenticated owner checks, canonical-only attribution and corrections; qualified item totals do not include them. The fixed Store14 candidate, artifact verifier and eight-effect publisher bind telemetry-host/v0.6.0 and journal12. Candidate qualification requires eligible Linux x64, matching installed-package evidence and actual passive receipt correction/restore controls; a clean unsupported-storage refusal is not positive acceptance. Initial bounded local compilation and HTTP/schema controls passed at their original scope. Repaired tests use the existing exclusive collection for process-global Console and environment state; early CI includes the actual HTTP/schema and native output controls without dropping full-suite coverage. The original parallel Console failure is retained with cause unproved. This repaired source is independently reviewed; its full hosted, candidate, downloaded-package and service adoption gates remain separate and pending. Published Host 0.5.0 and its original schema14 source/journal11, prior 0.4 profiles and every immutable artifact remain unchanged. This is independently versioned from the accepted coherent CLI/Kit/Drivers 0.106 publication; active installed 0.105 selection stays separate. Existing TLS and bearer API capability does not establish actual receiver endpoint, trust, enrollment, backup or readiness. Home owns stable receiver metadata; local producer capture remains useful without receiver credentials. Registry declarations, source review and local controls do not authorize publication or establish receiver adoption.
title: Host 0.6 source accepts partial passive usage; receiver adoption is separate
